first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, so simplifying onboarding is the most direct and potentially durable response. Verify the prior onboarding result and the competitor-relevant pricing evidence before committing; guard against improving superficial activation while weakening qualified revenue or customer quality.

final.rationale: Run a standard guarded experiment simplifying onboarding, since the confirmed prior result improved completion by 13%, reduced time-to-value by 2.1 days, and increased 30-day retention by 3%—directly addressing both current declines. Use activation and onboarding completion as leading metrics, with 30-day retention and qualified revenue guardrails. Do not pursue promotional pricing: although it lifted qualified revenue 18% short term, retention fell 12%, conflicting with sustainable long-term growth.
